comparison_coverage.scope: descriptive coverage only; no comparison outcome analysis

interpretation_limits: Prediction errors are descriptive for selected feedback on uniform-random calibration trajectories.
They do not establish causal benefit or action ranking.
No per-decision unchosen outcomes were created.
No multi-step or whole-policy off-policy evaluation was performed.
Comparison outputs are used only to report stream and log coverage.
Discounted evidence mass is not an effective sample size and is not reported as ESS.
Action-specific selected-feedback prediction errors do not distinguish common state difficulty from action-specific contrast, and do not support action ranking.

model_parameters.initial_model_state: zero target vectors and ridge identity Gram matrices

scoring.normalization: none; raw logged features are used without full-stream normalization
scoring.outcome_scope: selected-action labels only; no unchosen-action outcomes imputed
scoring.sequence: predict selected action before reading that decision's selected feedback update; then update only selected action if model_updated
